'''Feyyaz Ferdusi''' was a [[Nduuati]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] as well as an accomplished [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]]. He lost a swoop race only once to a rookie named [[Jobany Cyrs]] on [[Najiba/Legends|Najiba]].
